# Dependencies

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(showtext)
library(patchwork)

```

# Load data

```{r}

round1 <- read_csv("../data/round 1 - delphi/Delphi raw1.csv") %>% 
  clean_names() |>
  slice(3:n())

```

# Cleaning

```{r}

valid_years_raw <- c(
  "0 - 5 years",
  "6 - 10 years",
  "11 - 20 years",
  "20+ years"
)

demo_clean <- round1 %>%
  mutate(
    sector_clean  = ifelse(!is.na(sector) & sector != "", sector, NA_character_),
    sector_list   = str_split(sector_clean, ";") %>% map(~trimws(.x)),
    sector_other  = sector_6_text,
    perspective_clean = ifelse(!is.na(perspective) & perspective != "", perspective, NA_character_),
    perspective_list  = str_split(perspective_clean, ";") %>% map(~trimws(.x)),
    perspective_other = perspective_6_text,
    job_title = str_squish(role),
    country_clean = str_squish(country),
    years = factor(years, ordered = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(
    response_id,
    sector_list,
    sector_other,
    perspective_list,
    perspective_other,
    job_title,
    country_clean,
    years
  ) |>
  mutate(years_clean = case_when(
      years %in% valid_years_raw ~ years,
      TRUE ~ "0 - 5 years"
    ),
    years_clean = recode(
      years_clean,
      "0 - 5 years"   = "0–5 years",
      "6 - 10 years"  = "6–10 years",
      "11 - 20 years" = "11–20 years",
      "20+ years"     = "20+ years"
    ),
    years_clean = factor(
      years_clean,
      levels = c("0–5 years", "6–10 years", "11–20 years", "20+ years"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

```

# Descriptives

## N

```{r}
n_participants <- nrow(demo_clean)
n_participants
```

## Years in the field

clean + plot from raw

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=6}

# Summarise
years_summary <- demo_clean %>% count(years_clean, sort = FALSE)

years_summary

##plot 
plot_years_summary <- years_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = years_clean, y = n, fill = years_clean)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0–5 years"   = "#B7A5D3",
      "6–10 years"  = "#386da6",
      "11–20 years" = "#52376b",
      "20+ years"   = "#12204d"
    )
  ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 40), breaks = seq(0, 40, 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "Years of Experience",
    y = "Number of Participants",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +   # ← increased font size
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10))
  )

plot_years_summary

ggsave(
  filename = "../data/outputs/round 1 years_experience_plot.png",
  plot = last_plot(),
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)

```

## sector

```{r}
## normal pie chart (no % labels)
keep_levels <- c(
  "Academic researcher",
  "Industry professional",
  "Civil society or nonprofit representative",
  "Policy or government advisor",
  "Research funder or philanthropic representative",
  "Other"
)

sector_palette <- c(
  "Academic researcher" = "#B7A5D3",
  "Industry professional" = "#8FA7CC",
  "Civil society or nonprofit representative" = "#386DA6",
  "Policy or government advisor" = "#2B537C",
  "Research funder or philanthropic representative" = "#52376B",
  "Other" = "#7B4F97"
)

sector_one <- demo_clean %>%
  unnest(sector_list) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sector_list), sector_list != "") %>%
  mutate(sector = str_squish(sector_list)) %>%
  mutate(sector = recode(
    sector,
    "Industry professional (e.g., developer, designer, platform representative, in-house counsel)" = "Industry professional",
    "Other (please specify)" = "Other"
  )) %>%
  distinct(response_id, sector) %>%
  filter(sector %in% keep_levels) %>%
  mutate(sector = factor(sector, levels = keep_levels))

sector_summary <- sector_one %>%
  count(sector, sort = TRUE)

sector_plot <- ggplot(sector_summary, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = sector)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sector_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(fill = "Sector") +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

sector_plot

ggsave("../data/outputs/round 1 sector_pie.png", sector_plot, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../data/outputs/round 1 sector_pie.pdf", sector_plot, width = 6, height = 4)


```

## perspective

```{r}
## APA-formatted Perspectives pie chart (clean, minimal, with large labels)
persp_summary <- demo_clean |>
  unnest(perspective_list) |>
  slice(3:n()) |>
  count(perspective_list, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    perspective_list = recode(
      perspective_list,
      "Other (please specify)" = "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100)) |>
  mutate(perspective_list = case_when(
    perspective_list == "I focus on theoretical or conceptual understanding"    ~ "Theoretical or conceptual understanding",
    perspective_list == "I focus on gathering, analysing, or applying evidence" ~ "Gathering, analysing, or applying evidence",
    perspective_list == "I focus on policy, governance, or compliance"          ~ "Policy, governance, or compliance",
    perspective_list == "I bring a cross-cutting or integrative perspective"    ~ "Cross-cutting or integrative perspective",
    perspective_list == "I focus on strategy, planning, or implementation"      ~ "Strategy, planning, or implementation",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ), 
  perspective_list = fct_relevel(perspective_list, 
                                 "Theoretical or conceptual understanding",
                                 "Gathering, analysing, or applying evidence",
                                 "Policy, governance, or compliance",
                                 "Cross-cutting or integrative perspective",
                                 "Strategy, planning, or implementation",
                                 "Other"))

# 3. Custom 6-colour palette (your purple–blue aesthetic)
persp_palette <- c(
  "Cross-cutting or integrative perspective"            = "#B7A5D3",
  "Gathering, analysing, or applying evidence"          = "#8FA7CC",
  "Policy, governance, or compliance"                   = "#386DA6",
  "Strategy, planning, or implementation"               = "#2B537C",
  "Theoretical or conceptual understanding"             = "#52376B",
  "Other"                                               = "#7B4F97"
)

# 5. APA-formatted pie chart
# persp_plot <- persp_summary %>%
#   ggplot(aes(x = "", y = n, fill = perspective_list)) +
#   geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
#   coord_polar(theta = "y") +
#   geom_text(
#     aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")),
#     position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
#     size = 5,                 # ← LARGE, readable labels
#     colour = "black"
#   ) +
#   scale_fill_manual(values = persp_palette) +
#   labs(fill = "Perspective") +
#   theme_void(base_size = 10) +        # ← bigger base font for readability
#   theme(
#     legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
#     legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
#     legend.position = "right"
#   )

persp_plot <- persp_summary %>%
  # 1. Change x to numeric '1' to allow radial adjustment
  ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = n, fill = perspective_list)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    # 2. Set x > 1 to move text outward. Play with 1.2, 1.3, etc.
    aes(label = paste0(pct, "%"), x = 1.25),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 5,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = persp_palette) +
  labs(fill = "Perspective") +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Print the APA plot
persp_plot

# 6. APA-appropriate export sizes (PNG + PDF)
ggsave(
  filename = "../data/outputs/round 1 perspectives_pie.png",
  plot = persp_plot,
  width = 6,      # APA figure width (can use 3.25, 5, or 6.5 depending on manuscript)
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)


```

## Combined plot for figure 1

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}

plot_years_summary <- years_summary %>%
  mutate(years_clean = case_when(years_clean == "0–5 years"   ~ "0-5",			
                                 years_clean == "6–10 years"  ~ "6–10",
                                 years_clean == "11–20 years" ~ "11–20",
                                 years_clean == "20+ years"   ~ "20+"),
         years_clean = fct_relevel(years_clean, 
                                   "0-5",	
                                   "6–10",
                                   "11–20",
                                   "20+")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = years_clean, y = n, fill = years_clean)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0-5"   = "#B7A5D3",
      "6–10"  = "#386da6",
      "11–20" = "#52376b",
      "20+"   = "#12204d"
    )
  ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 40), breaks = seq(0, 40, 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "Years of Experience",
    y = "Number of Participants",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +   # ← increased font size
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10))
  )


persp_plot <- persp_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = n, fill = perspective_list)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(pct, "%"), x = 1.25),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 5,
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = persp_palette) +
  
  # --- NEW: Remove axis padding to maximize pie size ---
  # limits=c(0.5, 1.5) tightly fits the pie (since width=1 at x=1)
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.5), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  labs(fill = "Perspective") +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    # --- NEW: Remove outer white margins ---
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0) 
  )

# plot_years_summary + plot_spacer() + persp_plot + 
#   plot_layout(ncol = 3, widths = c(1.75, 0.2, 1))

plot_combined <- plot_years_summary + plot_spacer() + persp_plot + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, widths = c(1.2, 0.1, 1.6))


ggsave(
  filename = "../data/outputs/round 1 figure_1.pdf",
  plot = plot_combined,
  width = 10,
  height = 4
)


```
